slides.t: It's only as good as what you tell it.
slides.s: "Write an email" gets you something generic.
slides.x: "I own a bakery. A customer's order was late. Write a short apology and offer 10% off."

slides.t: The prompts small business owners actually use.
slides.s: Copy, paste, fill in the brackets. Works in Claude or ChatGPT.

slides.x: "Reply to this customer. Short and friendly. Answer the question and offer a time to book: [message]"
"Write a 2 sentence follow up on a quote I sent 3 days ago. No pressure."
"Write a short text asking a happy customer for a Google review. Keep it casual."
"A customer says I'm too expensive. Help me explain my price clearly and politely."
"Here's my to do list. Order it by what brings in money first: [list]"
"Write a calm, professional reply to this review: [review]"
"Give me 5 short captions about [what I did today]. Plain language, no hashtags."
"Ask me 5 questions about my business, then write instructions so you always answer the way I would."

slides.s: Comment BRAIN and I'll send these back with your business details filled in.

Go to claude.ai or download the app.

slides.t: Write like you're texting a capable assistant.
slides.s: No special wording needed. Say what you need.

slides.x: "I run a cleaning business in Miami."
slides.s2: One line of context changes every answer.

slides.s: Emails, reviews, your menu, a photo of a receipt. It can read them.
